paths.view.tooltip: Show the paths AI traffic and people use in the view from above: roads blue, footpaths green, rails yellow; wide with the right of way, dashed where they give way, red rings where no other path joins. They show closer in than {meters, number, 0.#} m per pixel.
paths.reading: Finding the AI paths of the map...
paths.described: {count, plural, one {# AI path} other {# AI paths}} shown, {open} with an end no other path joins{zoom, select, yes {; zoom in to see them.} other {.}}
@paths.described: {zoom} is yes or no and chooses the ending: keep it in English

paths.status.open_end: Open end {n} of {total}: the {which, select, start {start} other {end}} of path {path} of {kind, select, spline {spline #{id}} other {object #{id}}} on tile {tileX}, {tileY} - no other {noun} joins it.

paths.heading: AI paths  {count}

paths.skipped: {count, plural, one {# spline chosen has} other {# splines chosen have}} another road type; its lanes are numbered otherwise, so it is left out.
paths.chip.tooltip: Path {n}; click more to change several
paths.speed.tooltip: Empty for none; AI traffic then keeps to the speed of the road

paths.level.normal: The map's normal random traffic, without a rule
